items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Tom Benton, yeah that was his guitar player. Played with him a long time.

ctx.x: He was the same one was with Jack Carey, huh? Yeah, same one.

Same guy. Yeah. And guitar, Tom Benton. Boy, he's getting me back there to think now. I got to think about them kind of fellas, you know, Tom Benton, yeah that was his guitar player. Played with him a long time.
Did he have a good drummer then?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Yeah. Tom Benton most of the time.

ctx.x: Who was guitar with Carey? What did you say? With Carey?
Yeah. Tom Benton most of the time.
Oh, yeah, I met him once. Yeah, Tom Benton.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, he worked with him and Jack Carey Band.

ctx.x: What about Tom Benton? Did you ever work with him?
Yeah, he worked with him and Jack Carey Band. He was a banjo player.
